# template_server (Resource)

Generates a set of UUIDs and keeps them in state. The UUIDs are regenerated only when `uuid_count` changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "template_server" "test" {
  uuid_count = 5

  # Optional delays, in seconds, that simulate a slow API.
  creation_delay = 5
  update_delay   = 3
  deletion_delay = 2
}

output "generated_uuids" {
  value = template_server.test.uuids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid_count` (Number) Number of UUIDs to generate, from 1 to 100.

### Optional

- `creation_delay` (Number) Seconds to wait before creating the server, simulating a slow API. Defaults to `0`.
- `deletion_delay` (Number) Seconds to wait before deleting the server, simulating a slow API. Defaults to `0`.
- `update_delay` (Number) Seconds to wait before updating the server, simulating a slow API. Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the server, generated on creation.
- `uuids` (List of String) The generated UUIDs.
